passages.excerpt_preview: Jalsaghar studies aristocratic decline; Mahanagar follows a working woman in Calcutta; Charulata adapts Tagore; and the Calcutta films confront a changing post-independence city.
Ray’s films range beyond the Apu Trilogy across family life, gender, class, modernity, urban work, colonial history and political disillusionment.
These themes are critical interpretations grounded in films, not statements Ray necessarily made about himself.
